identity: Le cinéma for alto saxophone, tenor saxophone and piano
findings: Zen-On identifies a trio with two separate saxophonists and piano, duration about 9 minutes, edition SEO-036, ISBN 9784115600362.
Published 15 August 2026 with 24-page score and two four-page parts. Publisher credits supervision to Nobuya Sugawa.
Premiere 14 February 2026, Himawari-no-Sato Hall: Nobuya Sugawa, alto; Sumichika Arimura, tenor; Minako Koyanagi, piano.
Publisher characterizes an original dramatic work themed on love with an open narrative. Release year and premiere support 2026 activity but do not independently prove composition year.
